name: medium-research-lemmy
description: Lemmy research with normalized MCP output. Wraps the federated Lemmy 0.19+ API v3 (lemmy_hot, lemmy_search, lemmy_post) against a configured instance (default programming.dev), reading anonymously by default. When LEMMY_* credentials are set, reads carry an Authorization: Bearer <jwt> from the shared auth path (D-06). IMPORTANT: authenticated reads require LEMMY_INSTANCE to be set explicitly (even to the default https://programming.dev) alongside LEMMY_USERNAME/LEMMY_PASSWORD; with username/password set but LEMMY_INSTANCE unset, reads stay anonymous by design (no error). Secrets follow the .mcpb keychain pattern ("sensitive": true, injected via ${user_config.*} into mcp_config.env). Actual .mcpb packing is deferred to v2 (PKG-01); this manifest is documentation/scaffold only.

lemmy_instance.title: Lemmy instance URL
lemmy_instance.description: Optional — full HTTPS base URL of the Lemmy instance to read (default https://programming.dev). REQUIRED for authenticated reads: LEMMY_INSTANCE must be set explicitly (even to the default https://programming.dev) alongside LEMMY_USERNAME/LEMMY_PASSWORD, or reads stay anonymous by design (no error).

lemmy_username.title: Lemmy username
lemmy_username.description: Optional — enables authenticated reads. Authenticated reads require LEMMY_INSTANCE to be set explicitly (even to the default https://programming.dev) together with LEMMY_USERNAME/LEMMY_PASSWORD; username/password alone (LEMMY_INSTANCE unset) yields anonymous reads with no error.

lemmy_password.title: Lemmy password
lemmy_password.description: Optional — in-memory only, never logged. Enables authenticated reads. Authenticated reads require LEMMY_INSTANCE to be set explicitly (even to the default https://programming.dev) together with LEMMY_USERNAME/LEMMY_PASSWORD; absent LEMMY_INSTANCE, reads are anonymous by design (no error).
